before:
name: slideshow_guide
description: >
  A starting point for guides: a four-step slideshow that walks a reader through two other boxes
  in the same document. Run `tour` and follow the links in its note. Step one selects the guide
  itself; step two selects `numbers` and draws a line from the note to it, counting your visits
  with onEnter and a {{visits}} template; step three opens `squares` at line 3, highlights it and
  draws a dashed line to that line; step four has a #custom: link whose callback changes a value
  the note shows, then Start again and Finish.

  Companion to public/docs/interactive_guides.md. Pure CPU; no Window, no Renderer. The notes and
  selections need a browser to be seen; headless, every box still runs.
operations:
  - create:
      box: sg_numbers
      name: numbers
      frame: { x: 60.0, y: 320.0, w: 150.0, h: 50.0 }
      properties:
        code: |
          // Ten numbers for squares to use.
          val numbers = (1..10).toList()
          println(numbers)
  - create:
      box: sg_squares
      name: squares
      frame: { x: 60.0, y: 440.0, w: 150.0, h: 50.0 }
      properties:
        code: |
          // Squares of the numbers 1 to 10.
          val numbers = (1..10).toList()
          val squares = numbers.map { it * it }
          println(squares)
  - create:
      box: sg_tour
      name: tour
      frame: { x: 60.0, y: 140.0, w: 150.0, h: 50.0 }
      properties:
        code: |
          // A four-step guide to this document. Run it, then follow the links in the note.
          val guide = thisBox
          val numbersBox = inside.boxes.values.first { it.name == "numbers" }
          val squaresBox = inside.boxes.values.first { it.name == "squares" }
          var visits = 0
          var stars = 0
          //%-

          val show = slideShow {
              step("Welcome") {
                  markdownNote(
                      """
                      ## A tour of this document
                      This guide has four steps. Each one selects the box it is about.

                      [[next:Start →]]
                      """.trimIndent(),
                      animated = true
                  )
                  selectBox(guide)
              }
              step("numbers") {
                  onEnter {
                      visits += 1
                      guide.properties["visits"] = visits
                  }
                  markdownNote(
                      """
                      ## `numbers` makes a list
                      The green line points at it. Visits to this step: **{{visits}}**.

                      [[back]] [[next]]
                      """.trimIndent(),
                      animated = true
                  )
                  selectBox(numbersBox)
                  annotate(id = "numbers", targetBox = numbersBox, color = "rgba(128, 255, 164, 0.8)", dashed = false)
              }
              step("squares") {
                  markdownNote(
                      """
                      ## Line 3 does the work
                      `squares` maps each number to its square.

                      [[back]] [[next]]
                      """.trimIndent(),
                      animated = true
                  )
                  selectBox(squaresBox, property = "code", line = 3, highlight = 3)
                  annotateToLine(id = "line3", targetBox = squaresBox, line = 3, color = "rgba(255, 180, 100, 0.8)", dashed = true)
              }
              step("Your turn") {
                  markdownNote(
                      """
                      ## Your turn
                      [Give this guide a star](#custom:star). Stars so far: **{{stars}}**.

                      [[home:Start again]] [[finish]]
                      """.trimIndent(),
                      animated = true
                  )
                  linkCallback("star") {
                      stars += 1
                      here.properties["stars"] = stars
                      show.goToStep(show.currentStepIndex)
                  }
                  selectBox(guide)
              }
          }

          runBlocking { show.start() }
  - execute:
      box: sg_numbers
      property: code
  - execute:
      box: sg_squares
      property: code
  - execute:
      box: sg_tour
      property: code
